rows.en: (What should I do for fun in the Shibuya Area today?)

(Oh, it's one of Sheryl's songs...
They say nobody in this galaxy goes a day without
hearing Sheryl sing, and it's really true.)

We're giving away signed Sheryl autograph cards
in a prize drawing right now!
Everyone, be sure to enter!

(Huh, I might be able to get
a signed Sheryl autograph card...
Maybe I'll enter too?)

(And the last one is "What would you love
Sheryl to do?" Hmm...)

(I know!
It might be fun if Sheryl came to visit
Mihoshi Academy. Umm...)

("Please come visit Mihoshi Academy High School
in the Frontier fleet sometime.")

("I'm sure you'll have a great time unlike
anything even you have experienced, Sheryl.")

(...There, something like that.
Well, it's not like Sheryl would ever actually come.)

I hope I win that signed card.)

c21614: Gary's 'Merry Christmas tte yatsu da' rendered 'Merry Christmas and all that'.

c21617/c21625: shared by the Gary, Hilda, Claire and Klan scenes; the reply 'You're right.' answers each partner's 'let's enjoy the party' line.
